calendar.note: VAT returns and payment are due 28 days after each tax period (usually quarterly). Corporate tax returns and payment are due nine months after the financial year (30 September for a calendar year).

workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.

items.name: corporate_tax
items.label: Corporate tax 9% on taxable profit above AED 375,000, only above AED 3 million of revenue: at or below it the business can elect Small Business Relief (no taxable income) for tax periods ending by 31 December 2029

notes: There is no personal income tax. Corporate tax is 0% on taxable income up to AED 375,000 and 9% above.

Small Business Relief: a resident business (including a freelancer with a licence) whose revenue is AED 3 million or less in the period and every earlier period can elect to be treated as having no taxable income, for tax periods ending on or before 31 December 2029 (Ministerial Decision No. 131 of 2026, extending the original end of 2026). It must be elected in each corporate tax return; qualifying free zone persons and members of large multinational groups cannot use it. The estimate assumes the election.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
